name: Decreto nº 12.880, de 18 de março de 2026 — Regulamenta a Lei nº 15.211, de 17 de setembro de 2025 (ECA Digital)
description: Brazilian presidential decree regulating Law 15.211/2025 (ECA Digital), designating the National Data Protection Authority (ANPD) as the lead administrative enforcement authority and establishing compliance obligations for digital services, conversational agents, large language models, and natural-language AI interfaces accessible to minors.
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by Presidência da República do Brasil (planalto.gov.br) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within Presidência da República do Brasil (planalto.gov.br).
